versions.subject: fix: indentation of conditions
versions.detection:
selection:
   Image|endswith: 'schtasks.exe'
   CommandLine|contains: '/Create '
   ParentImage|contains:
      - '\AppData\Local\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\Temporary Internet'
      - '\Users\Public\'
condition: selection

versions.subject: fix: FPs with new task scheduler rule
versions.detection:
selection:
   Image|endswith: 'schtasks.exe'
   CommandLine|contains: '/Create '
   ParentImage|contains:
      - '\AppData\Local\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\Temporary Internet'
      - '\Users\Public\'
filter:
   CommandLine|contains:
      - 'update_task.xml'
      - 'unattended.ini'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: Image="*schtasks.exe" CommandLine="*/Create *" ParentImage IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\*", "*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*", "*\\Temporary Internet*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*") NOT (CommandLine IN ("*update_task.xml*", "*unattended.ini*"))
